aboutParas: The ProffMusic boutique is kept by Kotsart HayprofFlex — the composer his circle simply calls Prof. His melodies are born in silence and settle into their purpose the way rare meteorites settle into an open palm: weightlessly and forever.

Every piece here is a living instrument, recorded with no intermediaries between soul and sound. Some tracks stir the body, making the pulse beat in time; others fortify the spirit, gathering scattered thoughts into a single line.
Prof works without haste and without formulas. If the finished sound is not there yet — he will compose it for you personally, from the first idea to the final pause.
licenseParas: Every purchase in the boutique is a commercial license between you and the keeper of the boutique. It grants the right to use the track in your works: video, advertising, podcasts, games and other projects.
Allowed: use the track in commercial and non-commercial projects without per-view fees; monetise content on any platform; make reasonable modifications — tempo, key, editing.
Not allowed: resell the track as a standalone product, pass it off as your own composition, or distribute the raw audio file without a purchase.
The license is perpetual and takes effect upon payment. If you need non-standard use — write to the creator personally.
static.contactsLead: If you need a melody that is not yet in the catalog, write to Prof personally. He answers himself, with no intermediaries.
static.contactsBody: In your letter tell him: what the music is for, what mood, what instruments and what deadlines. The master will heed every word.

rulesParas: The boutique is open to everyone who seeks a rare sound. Few but firm rules apply here, so that the catalog stays clean and communication stays respectful.
The content of the site — covers, titles, descriptions and texts — belongs to the keeper of the boutique. Do not copy it without permission and do not pass it off as your own.
Tracks may be listened to for preview and purchased for use. Circumventing protection or attempting to obtain a file bypassing purchase violates the rules and terminates access to the boutique.
In communication with the creator and other collectors, keep the order: no rudeness, spam or off-topic content. Violators lose access without warning.
The rules may be refined; all changes are published on this page and take effect upon publication.
privacyParas: The boutique collects only the data needed for the purpose: name, email and order details. Nothing extra — following the master's principle of never adding a single unnecessary note.
Email is used to deliver the track, confirm the purchase and answer letters. Order processing keeps purchase history so you can return to your tracks.
We do not sell or pass your data to third parties. Payment data is processed by the payment service directly — the boutique never sees or stores it.
The site may use standard technical analytics tools that help understand which pages are useful. They do not collect personal information about you.
If you have questions about data — write to the creator at shop{'@'}proffmusic.shop, and he will answer personally.
gdprParas: If you are in the European Economic Area, the data protection law (GDPR) grants you specific rights regarding your data. The boutique honours them in full.
You have the right to access your data, correct inaccuracies and delete your account along with order history if it is no longer needed.
You have the right to restrict processing, object to it and receive your data in a portable format. To do so write to shop{'@'}proffmusic.shop — the request is fulfilled within 30 days.
If you believe your rights have been violated, you may lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of your country.
Data is kept only as long as needed for the boutique to work: while the account lives or while the law requires keeping purchase records.
legal.termsTitle: Terms of Sale of Digital Goods
termsParas: A purchase in the boutique is the transfer of a digital good: the audio file and a perpetual license for its use, as described on the 'License' page.
After payment you receive a download link. The link is valid for a limited time and is available in your profile — save the file once received.

Digital goods are not subject to return after download, as is proper for sound you have already received. If the file is corrupted or the purchase was not delivered — write to the creator, and he will make it right personally.
Use of the track is governed by the license: you purchase the right to apply the music in your projects, not to resell it as a standalone product.
Payment is processed by the payment service; the boutique does not store payment data. Prices are shown in the catalog and may change, but the price of your order is fixed at the moment of payment.
